headline: Ratchet & Clank shares object and hero structures across its source
summary: Ratchet & Clank replaces many private object, hero, vector and controller structures with shared types while preserving compiled bytes. PAL v2.00 also rises from 78.51% to 78.63% matched code, with 4,225 of 5,109 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Five more implementations and a first-person camera argument fix land in #48, followed by smaller sound and level functions.
highlights: The large deletion count comes mainly from removing duplicate private structures, rather than removing game behaviour.
#49 proposes an exact implementation of the debug-menu drawing routine, closing a staged near miss. It has not merged.
